name: The First Book of KIM re-typeset edition

mentions.name: The First Book of KIM re-typeset edition
mentions.description: A re-creation of The First Book of KIM being rebuilt in the page-layout app Affinity Publisher to fix formatting, OCR errors, and mistakes present in the original, with a corrected new book/PDF edition planned for release online by the end of the year.
mentions.problem: The PDF scans of the book in circulation are not pretty, contain OCR errors, and the book itself has mistakes.
mentions.source_excerpt: As it happens, I am also fixing/formatting The First Book of KIM by recreating it in a modern page-layout app (Affinity Publisher). The PDF scans that are out there are not pretty, have OCR errors (and the book itself has mistakes). Hopefully I'll have a new version of the book/PDF out on the internet by the year's end.
